name: employee001
description: Ask your company's AI twins from Claude Code: search what colleagues decided, ask one twin, ask the whole company, or convene a short team meeting. Talks to your own self-hosted Employee001.

url.title: Employee001 MCP endpoint
url.description: Where your Employee001 app answers MCP. Keep the default for a local install started with `npx employee001 start`.

token.title: MCP token (optional)
token.description: Needed once sign-in is on, or for a LAN/Fly instance: the value of EMPLOYEE001_MCP_TOKEN (or EMPLOYEE001_TOKEN) from that instance's .env. Leave empty for a plain local install.
